strategies.name: Form Spread (single game)
strategies.description: Originate spread from offensive/defensive PPG matchup model; take the side only when |model - market| edge is within [1.0, 8.0] pts and all gates pass. Market input is unverified third-party (F-05) until checked at a licensed book.
strategies.status: active — Week 9 candidates listed on Model Lines page

strategies.name: Total Fishing (game totals)
strategies.description: Model total = sum of matchup projections. Trade only when model total differs from market total by >= 1.0 pt (totals from aggregators are unverified; most W9 totals were not captured — left blank by rule).
strategies.status: limited — only 1 third-party total captured (SF game, F-05); mostly NOT_COMPUTABLE this week

strategies.name: QB Prop Alignment
strategies.description: Project QB yards = season YPG * opponent pass-defense factor. Compare with licensed-book line (never from aggregators). Favor QBs behind pass-blocking issues (high SK) facing weak pass rush (low def SK) — e.g., CLE (33 SK taken) at NO.
strategies.status: active — projections on Prop Signals page

strategies.name: RB Workload vs Run Defense
strategies.description: Team rush projection vs opponent run-defense YPG allowed; allocate to lead back share (RB team affiliation is not rendered on the official leaders page — F-02 — so use team-level signal + official depth chart on nfl.com team pages before acting).
strategies.status: active — team-level projections only (individual allocation unverified)

strategies.name: WR Matchup vs Pass Defense
strategies.description: Team pass projection vs opponent pass defense; allocate by player share of team receiving (player YDS / team pass YDS). Injury adjustments from official nfl.com news (e.g., WAS WR McLaurin out for season -> target share redistributes).

strategies.name: De-correlated 2-leg Parlay
strategies.description: Pair two single-game candidates from DIFFERENT games (cross-game correlation ~0 by construction). Same-game parlays (SGP) are restricted: documented same-game proxy r(pass YDSpg, PFpg) = 0.67; legs like QB over + team over in the same game are mechanically correlated and are blocked when |r| >= 0.80.
strategies.status: active — build only from S1 candidate list

strategies.name: Same-Game Parlay (restricted)
strategies.description: Same-game combos are mechanically correlated (e.g., QB over + team over share the same drives). Default BLOCKED for correlated combos; only contrarian pairs (e.g., game total OVER + favorite spread UNDER, or game-script-negative pairs with r(pass YDSpg, rushYDSpg) = -0.32) may be submitted for review and must pass G5 with pair |r| < 0.80 from the computed correlation table.
strategies.status: restricted — correlated same-game combos BLOCKED; contrarian pairs reviewable; proxy r(passYDSpg,PFpg) = 0.67
